reason: As a backer who has lost money on a first-time creator, I'm won over by A's full refund if delivery is more than three months late, its update every two weeks, the reviewer's launch-week video, and its admission that most ratings came from the designer's own convention table. B leaves out the refund promise and the creator's name, and it still has a '[Game Title]' placeholder, which makes it feel less trustworthy.
